title: Failed after 2 years
text:
Failed after 2 years. I used this vacuum only occasionally. Less than once a month for small jobs. Two years after buying it, the power button failed. I first noticed it was difficult to turn on. After I finally got it on and wanted to turn it off, it didn't want to turn off. After hitting the button repeatedly I finally got it to turn off. The next time I wanted to use it it wouldn't turn on at all.
It's "currently unavailable" right now, so maybe they pulled this piece of junk. For $52 I would've hoped for more than 2 years of rare usage.
